# Example Store

> Example Store sells widgets with same-day dispatch across the EU; this file
> indexes the pages a language model needs to answer questions about us.

## Core
- [Products](https://example.com/products): full catalog with prices and availability
- [Shipping & returns](https://example.com/shipping): delivery times, costs, return policy
- [About](https://example.com/about): who we are, contact details

## Docs
- [API documentation](https://example.com/docs/api): REST API for orders and inventory
- [FAQ](https://example.com/faq): common questions, answered directly

## Legal
- [Terms of service](https://example.com/terms)
- [Privacy policy](https://example.com/privacy)
